title: CUTS HEAT vs CUTS PUMP
directVerdict: CUTS HEAT is the better fit for thermogenic and cutting, while CUTS PUMP is the better fit for pump.

Only CUTS PUMP discloses: Glycerol: 20 g per full serving; L-Carnitine: 1500 mg per full serving; L-Arginine AKG: 1000 mg per full serving; Pink Himalayan Salt: 500 mg per full serving.
CUTS HEAT caffeine: CUTS HEAT is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine. CUTS PUMP caffeine: CUTS PUMP is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine.
experience: CUTS HEAT: CUTS HEAT: A stimulant-free thermogenic formula positioned for daily consistency and stackability. The easiest concrete points are No disclosed caffeine, L-Carnitine and taurine, Stackable positioning. CUTS PUMP: CUTS PUMP: A caffeine-free liquid glycerol and L-Carnitine product positioned for hydration, pump, and stackability. tradeoffs: CUTS HEAT: Customers who specifically want stimulant energy
CUTS PUMP: Customers asking for stimulant energy
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: CUTS HEAT for thermogenic and cutting; CUTS PUMP for pump.
